newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Partek 8-mth profit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Partek 8-mth profit seen lower.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 70 million markka median forecast for Finnish construction materials and cargo equipment group Partek Oy Ab's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 21 at 0900/0600 GMT.

In January-August 1995, Partek's profit after financial items was 115 million markka. For Partek's full-year 1996 profit, five of the eight analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items of 192 million markka (mean 210 million) in a 110-286 million markka range.
Partek had a 270 million markka profit in 1995.
The data was collected in the first two weeks of October.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Interbank, Merita and Opstock. @
